data.name: Kai
data.gender_notes: Kai is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hawaiian kai, 'sea'; also a Frisian short form of names beginning with kai-. Its root is Hawaiian kai. A modern given name; the etymology varies by culture. Kai is a Hawaiian name meaning “Sea (in Hawaiian/Frisian); (also) earth”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kai expresses “Sea (in Hawaiian/Frisian); (also) earth”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hawaiian kai, 'sea'; also a Frisian short form of names beginning with kai-.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kai total 12, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
